scenarios.name: pandasai3-openai-setup-python312
scenarios.rationale: Response A states the 3.0.0 python<3.12 limit and gives a 3.11 venv, installs both packages, uses LiteLLM via pai.config.set with pai.read_csv(...).chat(...), and warns against SmartDataframe, pandasai.llm.OpenAI and the pandasai[openai] extra, while Response B blames the 2.x line, offers a speculative 3.12 pre-release path, and hedges on the API, so it falls short of the rubric's clear 3.0.0 explanation.

scenarios.name: join-two-csvs-and-chart
scenarios.rationale: B loads both CSVs with pai.read_csv, calls pai.chat with both frames, saves the chart via chart.save('exports/...png'), and tells the user to check last_code_executed to verify the join. A covers the first two items but relies on save_charts_path and an LLM-written save instead of the response's .save(), and never mentions last_code_executed.

scenarios.name: private-data-local-ollama-safety
scenarios.rationale: B gives the exact LiteLLM config with pai.config.set, says the LLM sees column names and sample rows, warns that code runs in-process and recommends sandbox=, and covers last_code_executed and multi-table failures; A hedges across v2 and v3, never mentions sandbox= or last_code_executed, and says nothing about multi-table questions.
